assertions.subject: vascular dementia
assertions.quote: Do not diagnose vascular dementia based solely on vascular lesion burden.

assertions.subject: vascular dementia
assertions.quote: If the dementia subtype is uncertain and vascular dementia is suspected, use MRI.

assertions.subject: young-onset vascular dementia
assertions.quote: Be aware that young-onset vascular dementia has a genetic cause in some people.
